verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents bulk user imports for database connections and gradual migration, and states you can migrate user data 'into and out of Auth0' with bulk imports and exports. However, a community user reports that getting an export that includes password hashes required raising a support ticket, so the no-lock-in exit path is not self-service. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that bulk import accepts password hashes, a self-service export that includes password hashes, and hands-on corroboration of a full round-trip migration.
